blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Peppermint Bizmoto Inc. (PBI), a leading financial technology rail that holds a regulatory electronic money issuer (EMI) license under the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP), has officially signed a strategic merchant payment services agreement with ARX (Asian Regulatory Exchange). Under the partnership, which was signed in Bonifacio Global City, Taguig, Peppermint will deploy its highly secure, National QR Code Standard (QR Ph) compliant person-to-merchant (P2M) settlement framework straight into ARX’s enterprise payment orchestration layer. The infrastructure enables frictionless, auditable digital transaction flows between individual customers and merchants within the heavily regulated gaming and amusement ecosystems.
